input: How can I check my VinBank account balance?
output:
To check your VinBank account balance, you can:

- Log in to your **online banking portal** at [vinbank.com](https://www.vinbank.com) and go to the **"Accounts"** or **"Balances"** section.
- Use the **VinBank mobile app** on your smartphone; tap **"My Account"** → **"Balance Inquiry"**.
- Call our **customer service line** (available on the back of your card or at `1-800-VIN-BANK`) for real-time assistance.

If you need help navigating either platform, just let me know!
